mission.name: idea-garnet-l2b-minimum-sealed-shelf
mission.tagline: Garnet has a strict MCP lifecycle core but no bounded tool host, raw-byte stdio transport, sealed local package boundary
mission.northStar: One frozen Core Ring Tier 1 tool executes in-process without widening to Tier 2, Tier 3, hosted registry, or arbitrary external hosts; A native-Windows raw-byte MCP session completes initialize, tools/list, tools/call, and error handling with byte-exact Content-Length frames; The same flagship package is accepted only with its committed matching seal and is rejected when unsealed, seal-stripped, or byte-tampered before tool execution; Two reporter runs over identical committed inputs emit byte-identical WV-6 verdict JSON

policies.notes: review until dogfood band 5 is routine; then auto.

phases.title: Core Ring Tier 1 freeze
phases.goal: Freeze exactly one repo-bundled Garnet tool and prove its interpreter invocation in-process before adding transport.

gates.title: Tier 1 in-process contract tests pass
gates.notes: 2/2 exact Tier 1 in-process tests passed on native Windows.

phases.title: Raw-byte stdio MCP host
phases.goal: Serve initialize, tools/list, tools/call, and protocol errors through bounded Content-Length frames using byte I/O only.

gates.title: Raw-byte stdio integration and adversarial tests pass
gates.notes: Exact-cure fresh LF and default-Windows checkouts both passed native stdio 2/2; framing core remains reviewer-approved.

phases.title: Sealed flagship baseline
phases.goal: Bind the frozen tool manifest, source, and Garnet seal into one excellent committed local package.

gates.title: Sealed package loads and executes end-to-end
gates.notes: Canonical reseal is byte-identical across two clean builds; exact-cure fresh LF and default-Windows checkouts both passed the sealed positive leg.

phases.title: Fail-closed negative proof
phases.goal: Reject missing, stripped, mismatched, and byte-tampered package inputs before any Garnet tool code executes.

gates.title: Unsealed and tampered package traps pass
gates.notes: All six traps remained green in exact-cure fresh LF and default-Windows checkouts.

phases.title: Deterministic Shelf reporter and WV-6 proof
phases.goal: Derive a deterministic verdict from committed artifacts only and satisfy the existing native-Windows WV-6 acceptance reporter.

gates.title: Minimum Shelf reporter emits deterministic accepted JSON
gates.notes: Verdict 03's authorized test-only truth pairing trips the reporter's broad post-runtime-candidate product diff. The reporter is fail-closed; no path exclusion or candidate rebind was made without review.

gates.title: WV-6 exact-candidate acceptance gate passes
gates.notes: Reporter-owned frozen evidence passes the unchanged WV-6 gate: accepted, 5/5 checks, 5 artifacts, findings empty. Squash-durable candidate rebinding remains a merge-boundary review question.

gates.title: Full Python battery has no regression against main
gates.notes: Verdict 03's protected truth-surface pairing is green. Exact python3 counts are now base 928/17F/8E/3S and lane 928/17F/8E/3S: zero lane delta. The inherited nonzero baseline remains recorded honestly.

risks.title: A host can appear MCP-capable while text-mode stdio corrupts framing or while seal validation occurs after Garnet code has already executed.
Current main still reports W-PLAY package and browser proof invalid
risks.note: Fresh reporters at cede73c say browser_package_valid=false and browser_proof_valid=false despite merged PR #509. This is outside Lane 2B; no browser claim is inherited or promoted here.

risks.title: The flagship in-toto predicate is an unsigned content attestation
risks.note: The loader pins canonical manifest/source/seal digests and re-derives AST/build/capability bindings. This proves reviewed local content, not external signer identity; the artifact and CLI label it UNSIGNED.

risks.title: WV acceptance truth surface is paired; final independent review remains
risks.note: Verdict 03 authorized the exact protected test change. Focused tests are 6/6 and full Python battery delta is zero; Binding 3 awaits Review 04.

risks.title: Shelf and WV-6 candidate provenance must survive the eventual squash merge
risks.note: The Shelf reporter binds branch runtime candidate a6f0da2 and the frozen WV manifest names e2820ce. The authorized test-only change also trips the reporter's broad product diff. Review 04 must authorize a content-bound landed-main contract or prescribe a post-merge ceremony.

nextActions: Wait for immutable Review 04. Verify its exact head/tree, then implement only the authorized content-bound Shelf/WV provenance repair with RED-before-GREEN and fresh LF/Windows plus independent Air replay.
blockers: The current Shelf reporter is red because the authorized test-only change is included by its broad post-candidate product diff; reporter logic is independently bound and cannot be changed without Review 04 authorization.
Reviewer must prescribe a squash-durable Shelf and WV-6 provenance contract that does not require branch-only commits or refs/pull/*.
Final approval of protected test Binding 3 and an Air two-fresh-checkout reporter replay remain pending.
